name: Honda XR250 (1979-1985)
engine: 248 cc air-cooled four-valve single, kick start
intro: The first XR250 off-road bikes. Tough four-stroke singles with simple carbs.

H: Air-cooled Honda singles need the valve clearance checked often. A tight exhaust valve is the usual cause of hard starting.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
